def boxfull(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[]
    for r in range(44,60):
        for c in range(64):
            if a[r][c] in 'Nc': cells.append((r,c))
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
# Currently at cols 16-21. Move left to 12-17, check; then 8-13, check; then 4-9, check
for target in [12, 8, 4]:
    while boxfull(current_frame)[2] > target:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':37,'col':1}])
    b=boxfull(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print(f"box={b} done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL DONE at box cols", b[2], "-", b[3]); break
</parameter>
